name: Plaguemist Ravine
summary: In western Plaguelands, sickly fog drifts south through Plaguemist Ravine. The narrow passage links the Hinterlands to Darrowmere Lake and offers a quiet, desolate route across the range.

sections.title: A Blighted Threshold
sections.body: Northwest of Quel'Danil Lodge, Plaguemist Ravine cuts between the Hinterlands and the Western Plaguelands. Lush, untamed highland forest lies to the south. Northward, the pass opens onto Caer Darrow and the blighted shores of Darrowmere Lake. The two realms could hardly be more different. Foul vapors creep south from the Plaguelands, meeting the crisp mountain air of the neighboring wilderness.

sections.title: A Quiet Passage
sections.body: Though the ravine cuts into Scourge-ravaged territory, it remains remarkably deserted. No wild beasts or wandering undead linger in the gorge. Its winding path makes a convenient, if ominous, back road for daring couriers and adventurers. They can use it to bypass the heavily fortified highways and border checkpoints leading into Lordaeron.

faq.answer: Plaguemist Ravine links the Hinterlands to the Western Plaguelands. Northward, it opens onto Darrowmere Lake's shores near the island fortress of Caer Darrow. Southward, it leads to forested hills northwest of Quel'Danil Lodge.

faq.q: Why is it called Plaguemist Ravine?
faq.answer: Plaguemist Ravine takes its name from the pervasive, blighted fog drifting south from the Western Plaguelands. The sickly air sharply contrasts with the fresh, uncorrupted atmosphere of the Hinterlands.

faq.q: Are there any enemies or NPCs in the ravine?
faq.answer: No hostile creatures, wildlife, or friendly non-player characters linger in Plaguemist Ravine. It is an unusually quiet passage between two active zones.

faq.q: How do you find the entrance in the Hinterlands?
faq.answer: In the Hinterlands, find the entrance in the northern mountain wall, west of Quel'Danil Lodge and north of Rhapsody Shindigger's campsite.

angles.text: As a hunter, you find a peaceful passage through the ravine. With no game or woodland beasts, it makes an eerie border as you track north into the Plaguelands.
As an Alliance scout stationed at Quel'Danil Lodge, you can use the pass as a discreet route to watch the blighted shores around Caer Darrow without facing open road patrols.
